title: Caffè TTC · minimal · six original scenes
status: Original artwork of a fictional café, created for educational comparison of interface styles
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: source artwork contact sheet for a fictional neighbourhood café website, six independent square images, never a website screenshot.
Primary request: one portrait bitmap, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels, arranged as a precise TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid. Each tile is a 512 x 512 square. Tiles meet edge to edge with NO gutters, borders, dividers, frames, captions, labels or interface elements. Keep every subject completely within its own tile; no object, decoration or person crosses a tile edge.
The six scenes belong to the SAME fictional welcoming café: muted teal painted walls, walnut wood bar and tables, warm brass pendant lamps, simple walnut chairs, white solid opaque ceramic cups, honest food and everyday hospitality.
Tile order and content:
TOP LEFT: close editorial still life of a WHOLE white ceramic espresso cup and saucer beside ONE WHOLE golden croissant on a walnut café table, with cosy teal wall and a hint of the café softly visible behind. Leave margin around complete food, cup and saucer.
TOP RIGHT: wider view of the same cosy café interior, walnut bar, brass lamps, teal wall, wooden chairs and two or three naturally posed patrons. Clear cafe spatial atmosphere, no writing anywhere.
MIDDLE LEFT: a WHOLE white opaque ceramic espresso cup and saucer plus a WHOLE larger white opaque ceramic cappuccino cup and saucer, cappuccino with simple latte art. Both cups completely visible.
MIDDLE RIGHT: a WHOLE golden croissant and a WHOLE cinnamon roll on a simple complete serving tray. The two pastries retain unmistakable real food shape and texture.
BOTTOM LEFT: a WHOLE clear glass of amber tea and a WHOLE clear glass of fresh orange juice, complete glasses visible with comfortable margin, warm drink tea and vivid orange juice distinct.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the exterior frontage of the same café, entire doorway and window in muted teal painted wood, a completely BLANK EMPTY sign panel with no characters or symbols, one potted leafy plant and two outdoor bistro tables. Keep the doorway and tables recognisable in the tile.
Composition: six complete crop-safe scene photographs or illustrations, one subject group per square. Enough distance to prevent plate, cup, pastry or glass being clipped. Maintain the exact 2-by-3 grid.
Text: none. Completely blank sign. No letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, marks, watermarks, menu boards, labels or typography. No UI, controls, cards, screen frames, app chrome, browser chrome or website layout.

Style/medium: high-contrast monochrome BLACK AND WHITE editorial café photography. Entire sheet strictly grayscale, no colour tint. Carefully composed restrained scenes, strong light/shadow, simple neutral background, complete recognizable real food and cups, clear silhouettes, honest photographic material texture. The teal wall and walnut wood are translated into distinctive grayscale tones, with the same cafe architecture. No excessive blankness that hides subjects. Tea and juice are distinct through differing liquid values and identical order, still clear full glass forms.
